blocks.html: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) refers to the strategies, processes, and technologies used by businesses to manage interactions with prospects and customers throughout the entire sales lifecycle.

CRM is both a business approach and a software solution that helps organizations centralize customer data, streamline communication, and improve relationship management. It enables teams across sales, marketing, and customer support to collaborate more effectively and deliver a consistent customer experience.
A CRM system collects and organizes customer information and interactions in one place, allowing teams to:

items.html: Track leads and manage sales pipelines
Store contact details and communication history
Generate reports and insights for decision-making

blocks.html: Supports better customer retention and satisfaction
This centralized approach ensures better visibility and coordination across teams.
A sales team uses a CRM platform to track all interactions with prospects, schedule follow-ups, and monitor deal progress—ensuring no opportunity is missed and communication remains consistent.

Customer Relationship Management is essential for building and maintaining strong customer relationships. By leveraging CRM systems, businesses can streamline operations, improve collaboration, and drive better sales outcomes.
